content.text:
Use one instance per profile file inside the network-owning Utility Process. Writes are
validated before they are queued, serialized in caller order, flushed and then atomically renamed
over the previous file, so a failed replacement leaves the last committed file readable. Reads wait
for queued writes and return only committed metadata. No handle stays open between calls. The
canonical strict profile schema rejects credential or other additional fields; device credentials
belong exclusively to the Main-owned OS vault.

content.text: Call once from the bundled Utility entry that
`ElectronRemoteDesktop`

forks. The
function listens on
`process.parentPort`
and announces
`ready`

; Main then sends one
initialization with the absolute asset and storage paths. Initialization cross-checks the
application namespace, loads the routes through
`loadRoutes`

, validates the content policy with
its canonical schema and composes an
`ElectronRemoteUtility`

whose credential store is a bounded
request channel to Main's OS vault. Only the canonical list, pair, open, close and forget
controls are dispatched; every message is validated before use and each control receives one
correlated reply. The Main/Utility message protocol is internal to this package. A
`dispose`
message rejects pending credential requests, closes every owned socket and answers
`disposed`

;
Main owns the startup deadline and the bounded shutdown fallback.
